submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness achieves the best pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c among all candidates and thicknesses (4.602σ), clearly outperforming R1 and R3. This choice is within the allowed thickness range (1-6 cm) and should provide robust performance over the experiment's lifetime, based on project document review and absence of longevity concerns.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: R2 at 3 cm achieves a separation of 4.602σ, which is the highest among all radiator/thickness options considered.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: R2 is one of the three specified candidates.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.
requirements.evidence: Reviewed project documents and simulation summary did not indicate performance degradation for R2; performance stability assumptions hold.
Selected thickness is 3 cm, which is within the 1-6 cm requirement.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Final recommendation is R2 at 3 cm thickness.
